newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed forms insurance industry service.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed forms insurance industry service.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Information Systems & Technologies said on Tuesday it has formed a business that will provide products and service solutions to the insurance industry.
The Information Systems & Technologies' (IS&T's) Insurance Practice combines the systems integration expertise of Lockheed Martin Corp with IS&T's capabilities in the insurance industry.
Lockheed Martin Information Systems & Technologies said IS&T currently provides services such as document imaging and data warehousing to property-casualty and medical insurers as well as reinsurers.

These services and capabilities will be supported by IS&T's Center for Insurance Solutions -- a research and development resource for the analysis and resolution of insurance-specific technology challenges, the company said.
John Conrad, director of the Lockheed Martin IS&T Insurance Practice, said the company will help clients align their information technology strategies with their specific business requirements.

"Insurance companies need strong project management and systems engineering disciplines to exploit the competitive advantage potential of today's technologies," said Paul Theriault, IS&T's manager of insurance business development.
"Lockheed Martin is the only large-scale systems integrator that offers this to the commercial marketplace," he said.
Lockheed Martin IS&T has already worked with several large insurers.
GEICO Direct, one of the largest direct writers of automobile insurance in the United States, turned to Lockheed Martin IS&T in developing its 1-800 call center, the company said.

And Zurich Personal Insurance, a leading provider of multi-line property and casualty insurance, looked to IS&T for a client/server architecture assessment for its next-generation customer service system, the company said.
